[[Merumeru/Legends|Merumeru]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Wookiee Chieftain|Elder]], wielded a '''battle staff''' in combat. The [[Staff/Legends|staff]] was [[Color/Legends|brown]] and roughly half the height of Merumeru. He used the staff in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|invaded]] the Wookiee [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Merumeru gathered a [[Merumeru's volunteer soldiers|group]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and, holding the staff aloft, he roared for his soldiers to charge into battle against the Separatists.

==Description==
The battle [[Staff/Legends|staff]] that the [[Wookiee Chieftain|Wookiee Elder]] [[Merumeru/Legends|Merumeru]] owned was [[Color/Legends|brown]] in color and roughly half of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee's]] height, and could be wielded as a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] with one [[Limb/Legends|hand]].<ref name="db" />

==History==
Merumeru's staff was used in [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|battle]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when Merumeru led a [[Merumeru's volunteer soldiers|group]] of volunteer [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the defense of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], against an invasion launched by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the battle, Merumeru and his volunteer soldiers waited behind a barricade on the [[Beach/Legends|beachfront]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] for the Separatists to attack. When the Separatists arrived, Merumeru stood atop the barricade, waved his staff in the air, and roared, and he and the volunteer soldiers charged into battle.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Merumeru's battle staff first appeared in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="ROTS" /> A promotional picture of Merumeru wielding the staff was later printed in several sources.<ref name="ROTS Photo Comic">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Cine-Manga|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' Cine-Manga]]</ref><ref name="ROTS Storybook">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Movie Storybook]]''</ref> The weapon was eventually identified as a battle staff in Merumeru's entry in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]],<ref name="db" /> and was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' as a weapon that could be used by players of the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

During the filming of Merumeru's scenes for ''Revenge of the Sith'', [[Axel Dench]], who played the Wookiee, used a prop that looked like a long wand in place of the staff. The wand was later altered using computer-generated imagery to look like a battle staff.<ref name="The Wookis Are Back!">{{SW|url=video/the-wookiees-are-back|series=Making Episode III Webdocs|text=The Wookiees Are Back!}}</ref>
